title: Scarab network
description: Peer governor populations, discovery, churn, transport states and peer-event investigations. Existing node telemetry only; mainnet/preprod kept separate by single-node selection.

options.content: **Hot = active**, **warm = established minus active**, **cold = known minus established**. Ordinary and big-ledger peers are disjoint governor populations; totals below include both. Established includes closing/lingering peers and active includes deactivation in progress. Connection-manager states are a separate layer. Differences from governor counts can persist and require investigation; these are not interchangeable socket counts. Select one host and node to keep mainnet and preprod separate. The peer regex filters log investigations only. Missing data stays missing; event counters may be absent until their first occurrence. No per-peer RTT, bandwidth or lifetime peer roster is exported by the current node.

panels.title: At a glance · current scrape, not sampled block logs
Metrics reachable
panels.description: 1 means Prometheus scraped this node. Missing is not a healthy zero.

panels.title: Active / hot · total
panels.description: Ordinary active peers plus active big-ledger peers.

targets.expr: (max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ActivePeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ActiveBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

panels.title: Established · total
panels.description: Ordinary plus big-ledger established peers; includes hot and warm.

targets.expr: (max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_EstablishedPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_EstablishedBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

panels.title: Known · total
panels.description: All peers currently known to the governor, including cold peers.

targets.expr: (max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_KnownPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_KnownBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

panels.title: Manager established
panels.description: Connection-manager established entries. This separate layer is not the hot peer count.

panels.title: Peer slot lag
panels.description: Peer tip last reported on follower extension minus local slot; may be slightly negative. Zero lag is not proof of network reachability.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Ordinary temperatures
panels.description: Disjoint hot, warm and cold sets for this population. Ordinary excludes big-ledger peers.

panels.title: Ordinary population against targets
panels.description: Known contains established, which contains active: these series must not be stacked. Targets can change during scheduled churn.

panels.title: Big ledger temperatures
panels.description: Disjoint hot, warm and cold sets for this population. Ordinary excludes big-ledger peers.

panels.title: Big ledger population against targets
panels.description: Known contains established, which contains active: these series must not be stacked. Targets can change during scheduled churn.

panels.title: Total temperatures · both populations
panels.description: Hot + warm + cold equals all known peers across both populations.

targets.expr: (max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Hot_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_HotBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

(max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Warm_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_WarmBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

(max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_Cold_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) + max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ColdBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}))

panels.title: Active target shortfall
panels.description: Peers below each current active target. A transient shortfall is normal while promoting or churning.

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_selection_targets{host=~"$host", container=~"$container", target="Active"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ActivePeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}), 0)

clamp_min(max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_selection_targets{host=~"$host", container=~"$container", target="ActiveBigLedger"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_ActiveBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}), 0)

panels.title: Established target shortfall
panels.description: Warm reserve depletion and disconnected peer recovery are visible here.

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_selection_targets{host=~"$host", container=~"$container", target="Established"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_EstablishedPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}), 0)

clamp_min(max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_selection_targets{host=~"$host", container=~"$container", target="EstablishedBigLedger"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_peerSelection_EstablishedBigLedgerPeers_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}), 0)

panels.title: Discovery · origins, roots and ledger pool maps
Known peers by origin
panels.description: Origin is where a currently known address came from. Ledger and BigLedger prove discovery beyond configured roots; these are peers, not the number of stake pools.

panels.title: Ledger discovery pool maps
panels.description: Pools eligible in the ledger worker stake maps. Big is the leading 90% of stake; it overlaps the ordinary pool map. Do not add maps, and do not interpret pools as live connections.

panels.title: Local roots · explicit status
panels.description: Uses unambiguous LocalRootPeers gauges. Historical HotLocalRoots/WarmLocalRoots labels have reversed meanings and are deliberately not used.

panels.title: Bootstrap peers · explicit status
panels.description: Zero is normal when bootstrap peers are not configured. These peers are part of the ordinary population.

panels.title: Root discovery population
panels.description: Root count includes public roots including big-ledger roots, as in the reference governor. It is not the configured local root count.

panels.title: Genesis state
panels.description: One-hot Genesis State Machine phase. CaughtUp is a consensus freshness judgement.

panels.title: Trust, sensitivity and fetch mode
panels.description: Trust is the governor availability criterion, not a general network-health score. In Genesis mode it depends on sufficient active big-ledger peers. Sensitive means restricted peer selection due to an old ledger; Deadline is tip-oriented fetch mode.

panels.title: Root discovery and peer-sharing events
panels.description: Counts retained root-provider requests/results/failures, inbound picks and peer-share requests/results. Empty means no matching event in the interval. Requests and results are events, not unique discovered peers.

panels.title: Root-provider retry delay · recent decisions
panels.description: Largest retry delay decided in the trailing five minutes. Separate from individual peer promotion backoff. No recent root-provider decision yields no data; this is not a countdown.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (max_over_time({host=~"$host", container=~"$container", event=~"peerSelectionRoots"} | json | action=~"results|failure" | unwrap retryInSeconds | __error__="" [5m]))

panels.title: Peer movement · in-flight gauges, failures and churn
Ordinary promotions in flight
panels.description: Current concurrent governor jobs, not cumulative transition counters.

panels.title: Ordinary demotions in flight
panels.description: Current peers deactivating or closing. A plateau helps locate stuck transitions.

panels.title: Big ledger promotions in flight
panels.description: Current concurrent governor jobs, not cumulative transition counters.

panels.title: Big ledger demotions in flight
panels.description: Current peers deactivating or closing. A plateau helps locate stuck transitions.

panels.title: Peer stability · transition rates, failures and retry delays
Transitions completed or failed · per minute
panels.description: Successful promotions, demotions, failed jobs, asynchronous peer loss and forgetting. Counters are created on first event; absent outcomes mean unobserved, not a verified zero.

panels.title: Connection opens, closes and refusals · per minute
panels.description: Connection events at the transport manager. A refused connection differs from a failed governor promotion.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (host, container, event) (rate(scarab_connection_events_total{host=~"$host", container=~"$container", event!="Changed"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failure retry backoff
panels.description: Scheduled retry delays observed after failed promotion; not elapsed connection latency. No samples yields no quantile.

panels.title: Backoff observations · per minute
panels.description: Companion sample rate: zero observations makes backoff quantiles unavailable.

panels.title: Churn sleep chosen
panels.description: Most recently scheduled sleep before a churn round. This is not a live countdown.

panels.title: Churn rounds · per hour
panels.description: Scheduled rounds begun. A zero can be normal during the first scheduled wait.

panels.title: Churn steps · selected range
panels.description: Reached versus TimedOut per bounded churn step. Absent until first event.

targets.expr: sum by (host, container, step, result) (increase(scarab_peer_selection_churn_steps_total{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__range]))

panels.title: First-arrival observation boards
panels.description: Slots with first-header / first-block observations, bounded at 180 each. This reports board occupancy, not winning peer identities, latency or pool winners.

panels.title: Connection manager · transport states and direction
Connection state distribution
panels.description: Reserved → Unnegotiated → Established → Terminating → Terminated entries. Terminated entries may be removed promptly. This transport state is distinct from peer temperature.

panels.title: Inbound, outbound and duplex
panels.description: Inbound and outbound count nonterminated manager entries by who opened them, including reservations and negotiation in progress. Duplex describes bidirectional protocol capability and overlaps the direction counts. Do not add duplex to a connection total.

panels.title: Inbound session outcomes · per minute
panels.description: Accepted, negotiated capability, following, ended/dropped, refused/closed inbound events. An outbound-only node can legitimately have no inbound event series.

panels.title: ChainSync activity
panels.description: Headers includes rollback replies; aggregate across sessions, not unique blocks. Protocol waiting is part of round duration, so it is not network RTT.

panels.title: Investigate peers · retained JSON events, regex applies below
Top failed peer promotions · selected range
panels.description: Addresses and failure classes parsed at query time only, so they create no stored metric labels. Counts reflect retained logs; retries can dominate and are not unique peer counts.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (peer, failure) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", container=~"$container", event=~"peerSelectionPromote"} |~ "${peer:raw}" | json | action="failed" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Promotion failures by cause and starting state
panels.description: Failure class from the typed governor event. cold failures connect/handshake; warm failures activate. An empty table means no matching retained events, not independently proven network health.

targets.expr: sum by (failure, from) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", container=~"$container", event=~"peerSelectionPromote"} |~ "${peer:raw}" | json | action="failed" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed promotions and asynchronous peer loss
panels.description: Expand an event for peer, typed failure, retryInSeconds, forgotten flag or loss reason. Use the peer regex above to focus on an address; use ".*" for all.

panels.title: Peer promotions, demotions and forgetting
panels.description: Decisions and their outcomes. Decided events may contain arrays of peers; raw regex matches those too.

panels.title: Connection and inbound session lifecycle
panels.description: Open/close, handshake direction, duplex capability and session termination reasons. Does not claim a complete current peer roster: logs describe events over the selected interval.

panels.title: Discovery, ledger maps and peer sharing
panels.description: Inspect source Ledger, stake-map refreshes, skipped pool relays, root retries, peer-share requests/results and changing targets. Peer regex deliberately does not filter this global context.

panels.title: Churn, trust, Genesis and fetch mode timeline
panels.description: Explains deliberate target changes, churn timeouts, ledger freshness, trust and fetch mode changes. Peer regex deliberately does not filter these global events.
